jurnal_nenek.name: Grandmother's Notebook
jurnal_nenek.description: A cloth-bound notebook with a few pages already written in a careful hand. Whoever carries it is expected to fill the rest.

surat_izin.name: Village Travel Letter
surat_izin.description: A short letter with a stamp and a signature, asking the next village to receive you.

benang_jaring.name: Net Twine
benang_jaring.description: A roll of tough twine for mending fishing nets.

keranjang_kosong.name: Empty Basket
keranjang_kosong.description: A plain woven basket, useful for carrying anything the village sends with you.

keranjang_isi.name: Basket of Village Gifts
keranjang_isi.description: The basket now holds salt, coffee and dried fish - the village's gift to the road ahead.

bibit_padi.name: Rice Seedlings
bibit_padi.description: Bundles of young rice plants ready to be pressed into the mud of a wet field.

lilin_batik.name: Batik Wax
lilin_batik.description: A block of wax that smells faintly of resin; it melts clear and holds a line on cloth.

canting.name: Wax Pen
canting.description: A small copper pen with a bamboo handle, used to draw fine lines of hot wax onto cloth.

tabuh.name: Gamelan Mallet
tabuh.description: A padded wooden mallet. The padding is what keeps the bronze sounding soft rather than sharp.

naskah_wayang.name: Wayang Story Note
naskah_wayang.description: A page of cues and jokes in cramped handwriting, prepared for a night-long performance.

bumbu_tumpeng.name: Tumpeng Ingredients
bumbu_tumpeng.description: Turmeric, coconut, and the aromatics for a celebration cone of yellow rice.

ukiran_kayu.name: Carved Wood Panel
ukiran_kayu.description: An original abstract panel cut with a small knife. Its curves were invented for this game, not copied from any specific carving.

benang_songket.name: Gold Thread
benang_songket.description: A spool of shiny thread that is laid over the cloth instead of woven through it.

kain_ulos.name: Woven Cloth
kain_ulos.description: A warm, hand-woven cloth in deep reds and blacks, given as a blessing rather than sold.

bambu_saluang.name: Bamboo Flute Blank
bambu_saluang.description: A thin bamboo tube, cut to length and waiting for its finger holes.

piring_tari.name: Dance Plates
piring_tari.description: Two small ceramic plates, held in the palms during a harvest dance.

biji_kopi.name: Highland Coffee Beans
biji_kopi.description: Green coffee beans from the slopes around the lake, still smelling of the drying yard.

bumbu_rendang.name: Rendang Spice Bundle
bumbu_rendang.description: Chilli, ginger, turmeric, galangal and lemongrass, bundled in a banana leaf.

mentega_kelapa.name: Coconut Milk
mentega_kelapa.description: Thick milk squeezed from grated coconut - the liquid that carries all the spice.

rumpun_rotan.name: Rattan Bundle
rumpun_rotan.description: Long flexible canes, still with their outer skin, ready to be split and soaked.

getah_kemenyan.name: Aromatic Resin
getah_kemenyan.description: Lumps of tree resin that smell of smoke and sweetness when they burn.

kayu_ukiran.name: Carved House Post
kayu_ukiran.description: A short post carved with original hooking scrolls - invented for this game, not copied.

benang_sasirangan.name: Dye Thread
benang_sasirangan.description: Strong thread used to tie cloth tightly before it goes into the dye bath.

bibit_padi_ladang.name: Dry Field Seed
bibit_padi_ladang.description: A handful of seed rice kept for the dry fields, where the water comes only from the sky.

papan_phinisi.name: Ship Planking
papan_phinisi.description: A long board already shaped by hand and eye, ready to be fitted to a hull curve.

pasak_kayu.name: Wooden Pegs
pasak_kayu.description: Hard wooden pins. A wooden ship is held together with these instead of iron nails.

layar_kain.name: Sail Cloth
layar_kain.description: Heavy cloth, stitched and reinforced at the corners where the wind pulls hardest.

batang_kolintang.name: Kolintang Bar
batang_kolintang.description: One wooden bar of a tuned set; each bar rings a note when it is struck with a mallet.

benang_sutra.name: Silk Yarn
benang_sutra.description: Fine, strong yarn reeled by hand and dyed before it goes on the loom.

bumbu_coto.name: Coto Spice Mix
bumbu_coto.description: Coriander, cumin, lemongrass and roasted peanut - the base of a thick beef soup.

naskah_lontara.name: Palm Leaf Note
naskah_lontara.description: A palm-leaf strip with a line of old script scratched into it. Kept in the village archive.

serat_noken.name: Bark Fibre
serat_noken.description: Rough fibre stripped from inner bark, softened by soaking and beating.

bibit_ubi.name: Sweet Potato Cuttings
bibit_ubi.description: Vine cuttings to be pushed into the dark soil of a highland garden bed.

anyaman_tifa.name: Drum Skin
anyaman_tifa.description: A stretched skin, scraped thin and warm to the touch, waiting for a drum body.

gaung_papeda.name: Papeda Fork
gaung_papeda.description: A wooden fork cut with two prongs, used to lift sago porridge out of the bowl.

serat_kulit_kayu.name: Bark Cloth Square
serat_kulit_kayu.description: A soft sheet beaten out of inner bark, with an original geometric pattern painted on it.

sagu_kering.name: Dried Sago
sagu_kering.description: Dried sago starch in a leaf wrapper. Sago comes from the palm, not from a field.

ikan_kuning.name: Fish for Soup
ikan_kuning.description: Fresh fish, ready to be simmered with turmeric and lime for papeda.

col_ukiran_kecil.name: Carved Motif Token
col_ukiran_kecil.description: A small wooden token cut with an abstract curve. One of four highland keepsakes.

col_benang_emas.name: Gold Thread Skein
col_benang_emas.description: A finger-sized skein of metallic thread, wrapped round a bamboo core.

col_talempong_chip.name: Bronze Ding
col_talempong_chip.description: A little bronze disc that still rings faintly when it is tapped.

col_kopi_liar.name: Wild Coffee Bean
col_kopi_liar.description: A single roasted bean, dark and glossy, from a coffee tree that grows by itself.

col_lilin.name: Wax Curl
col_lilin.description: A curl of batik wax, translucent at the thin edge.

col_keping_gamelan.name: Bronze Key Plate
col_keping_gamelan.description: A small bronze plate from a gong-chime, tuned to a note you cannot quite sing.

col_batu_candi.name: Temple Stone Chip
col_batu_candi.description: A chip of grey stone with one corner of an abstract repeating pattern on it.

col_boneka_lidi.name: Lidi Puppet
col_boneka_lidi.description: A little puppet cut from a palm rib and painted - an original design, not a wayang figure.

col_manik_dayak.name: Bead
col_manik_dayak.description: A single glass bead in red and white, the kind traded upriver for centuries.

col_gelang_rotan.name: Rattan Ring
col_gelang_rotan.description: A bracelet of split rattan, sprung and worn smooth.

col_damar.name: Resin Lump
col_damar.description: Hardened tree resin that smells of the forest when it is warmed in the hand.

col_ukiran_kecil_kl.name: Carved Handle Piece
col_ukiran_kecil_kl.description: A small carved piece from a tool handle, cut with original hooking shapes.

col_keping_kolintang.name: Kolintang Key
col_keping_kolintang.description: A short wooden bar; tap it and the note sits somewhere between two of your own.

col_serat_sutra.name: Silk Thread
col_serat_sutra.description: A metre of raw silk thread, strong enough to cut your fingers if you pull it fast.

col_kerang.name: Harbour Shell
col_kerang.description: A ridged shell from the shallows, worn pale by sand and salt.

col_kulit_lontara.name: Script Fragment
col_kulit_lontara.description: A scrap of palm leaf with three marks of old script on it.

col_noken_kecil.name: Small Noken
col_noken_kecil.description: A knotted bag the size of your fist, made for carrying small things.

col_serat_sagu_kol.name: Sago Fibre Bundle
col_serat_sagu_kol.description: A bundle of pale fibres left over after the starch has been washed out.

col_batu_lukis.name: Painted Stone
col_batu_lukis.description: A smooth river stone painted with an original geometric pattern in earth colours.

col_bulu_molt.name: Moulted Plume
col_bulu_molt.description: A plume found on the forest floor, moulted naturally and picked up without disturbing any bird - protected species are never collected in this game.

sou_mini_rumah.name: Miniature Gadang House
sou_mini_rumah.description: A palm-sized model carved from soft wood with its roof sweeping into two points.

sou_kain_songket.name: Songket Scarf
sou_kain_songket.description: A short scarf with metallic thread worked through it.

sou_kopi_pak.name: Packet of Highland Coffee
sou_kopi_pak.description: Ground coffee folded into paper, ready to give as a gift.

sou_angklung_mini.name: Small Angklung
sou_angklung_mini.description: A two-tube bamboo shaker that plays one chord and no more.

sou_batik_syal.name: Batik Cloth Square
sou_batik_syal.description: A square of batik with an original pattern, folded and tied with string.

sou_gamelan_mini.name: Miniature Gamelan
sou_gamelan_mini.description: A tiny bronze-look plate and mallet mounted on a wooden stand.

sou_tas_rotan.name: Rattan Bag
sou_tas_rotan.description: A stiff little bag plaited from split cane, with a shoulder strap.

sou_sasirangan.name: Tie-dye Cloth
sou_sasirangan.description: A square of cloth dyed in rings and streaks where it was tied.

sou_topi_anyaman.name: Wide Woven Hat
sou_topi_anyaman.description: A broad hat that keeps both sun and rain off; it folds flat for the boat.

sou_perahu_mini.name: Model Sailing Ship
sou_perahu_mini.description: A model of a two-masted wooden ship, pegged together the way the real hulls are.

sou_sutra_kecil.name: Silk Sash
sou_sutra_kecil.description: A narrow hand-woven sash in deep colour, light enough to carry anywhere.

sou_kolintang_mini.name: Pocket Kolintang
sou_kolintang_mini.description: Four wooden bars on a frame small enough to fit in a bag.

sou_noken_tas.name: Knotted Noken
sou_noken_tas.description: A stretchy knotted bag; hang it from your head and the load rides on your back.

sou_ukiran_papua.name: Abstract Carved Plaque
sou_ukiran_papua.description: A small plaque carved with original curving shapes invented for this game.

sou_tifa_mini.name: Small Drum
sou_tifa_mini.description: A hand-sized drum with a skin head, quiet enough for a hut but not for a festival.

bekal_jalan.name: Travel Provisions
bekal_jalan.description: Cooked rice, salted fish and a little sambal wrapped in banana leaf. Eat it before it spoils.

air_minum.name: Water Flask
air_minum.description: A gourd of clean water. The highlands get cold; the lowlands get very hot.

sambal_botol.name: Bottle of Sambal
sambal_botol.description: Pounded chilli relish in a small bottle. Dangerous in large amounts.

lampu_minyak.name: Oil Lamp
lampu_minyak.description: A small lamp with a clay body and a rag wick; it burns low but it burns all night.

tali_tambang.name: Coil of Rope
tali_tambang.description: Twisted rope long enough to cross a stream or tie down a load.

peta_lipat.name: Folded Map
peta_lipat.description: A hand-copied map of river mouths and roads, with one corner chewed by a rat.

obat_herbal.name: Herbal Remedy
obat_herbal.description: Bitter leaves and root boiled down. Tastes awful; works well enough.

keranjang_bahu.name: Shoulder Basket
keranjang_bahu.description: A woven basket with a strap, for carrying things that do not fit in a bag.

pisau_serbaguna.name: Utility Knife
pisau_serbaguna.description: A short straight blade in a wooden sheath, used for everything from peeling to sharpening pegs.

pipa_bambu.name: Water Bamboo
pipa_bambu.description: A length of bamboo cut between the joints and used for carrying water.

kain_merah.name: Red Cloth
kain_merah.description: A plain square of red cloth, useful for wrapping, carrying or signalling.
